updated.name: Gohan's Energy Defense
updated.rules: Stops an energy attack. Raise your anger 1 level.
body_lines: Stops an energy attack. Raise your
anger 1 level.

updated.name: Krillin's Physical Defense
updated.rules: Play this card as a defense. If your opponent’s attack does life cards of damage to you, you may take the first life card of damage from that attack and place it in your hand instead of discarding it. If used by Krillin, this card stays in play to be used one more time this Combat.

updated.name: Krillin's Energy Attack
updated.rules: Energy attack doing 2 draws from the life card deck if not stopped. If used by Krillin, this card stays on the table to be used one more time in this combat.

updated.name: Raditz Energy Wall
updated.rules: Forces a Hero opponent in this combat to discard 1 life card from his deck. Discard this card from the game after use.

updated.name: Vegeta's Energy Blast
updated.rules: Saiyan Heritage only. Use when needed. This must be your first card played during Combat. Raise your Main Personality to its highest power stage. Remove from the game after use.
